title: Okay...
text: Okay.... This is okay...it is really sharp, well made with quality material,  however, I think I still prefer the little rolling wheel one.

product_metadata.title: RSVP International Endurance® Stainless Steel Precision Pierced Pizza Pan, 11.5" | Use on Grill or Oven | Brown Crispy Crust Without Burning Pizza | Dishwasher Safe
features: HELP IN THE KITCHEN: Our durable 18/8 stainless steel pizza pan gives you a delicious brown and crispy crust without burning the pizza.
QUALITY YOU CAN TRUST: Our quality stainless steel pizza pan cooks to perfection and features large handles for easy removal.
BAKE ANYWAY YOU LIKE: Can be used on the grill or in the oven. No need to sacrifice your favorite style of pizza.
PERFECTLY SIZED: Measures 12.75 inches in diameter on the outer rim and 11.25 inches in diameter on the inside. 1 inch tall.
EASY TO USE AND CLEAN: Dishwasher safe for quick and easy clean up.
description: Rsvp strives to offer quality kitchen products and cooking tools at competitive prices. Our RSVP endurance precision pierced pizza pan is a perfect example. Bake or grill a brilliantly browned pizza with the endurance precision pierced pizza pan. Crafted from quality 18/8 stainless steel, this pan is pierced to give your pie that often desired but elusive Brown and crispy bottom without burning the pizza. The pan is great for both ovens and grill and the luxurious side handles make it easy to transport from grill or oven to table. The pan is dishwasher safe for quick and easy clean up. Measures 12-3/4-inches in diameter on the outer rim and 11-1/4-inches in diameter on the inside, by 1-inch tall. Dishwasher safe. When all the right people, and ingredients, kitchen tools, and food come together, we call this the art of gathering.
